caller.voice: Her daughter, worried, in casual Singapore English. She knows only what she has seen: her mother is 76, has been breathless for two days and is worse lying down, sleeps on three pillows, and her legs are swollen. She has heart failure and kidney failure, goes for dialysis three times a week, and is on GTN.

answers.location: Blk 6xx Jurong West St 61, #09-xx. Ninth floor.
answers.whatHappened: My mother, 76 already. Two days she breathless, lie down even worse. At night must sleep on three pillows. Her legs also swollen. She got heart failure and kidney failure, go dialysis three times a week.
answers.conscious: Conscious, she can talk, but very breathless.
answers.icAndMeds: OK, I get her IC and her medicine box ready for you.

patient.name: Kamala d/o Raman
patient.voice: Breathless and tired. Speaks slowly in full sentences, stopping for breath between them.
patient.chiefComplaint: Two days I cannot breathe properly. When I lie down, worse.

lines.feelingNow: A bit better with the oxygen. Still breathless, but not so bad.
lines.hitHead: No, I never hit my head.
lines.neckPain: No, no pain at my neck.
lines.lungHistory: No asthma, no lung problem. My heart is weak, the doctor say heart failure.
lines.verbal: Kamala d/o Raman. I'm at home, in Jurong West.
lines.motor: OK, both arms up. Like this.
lines.position: I sit at the edge of the bed like this. If I lie down, I cannot breathe.
lines.bpScreen: Not my left arm, that one has my dialysis fistula. Use the right arm. No chest operation.
lines.ic: My IC is in my pocket, here.

scene.description: Bedroom, pillows stacked on the bed
hazards: medication box on the bed beside the patient

loc.response: Yes, I can hear you. Very hard to breathe.

spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

history.other: Heart failure, kidney failure on dialysis, high BP

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and strong

rbs.findings: No injuries; both lower legs swollen

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, crackles at both bases

ecg.reading: Sinus tachycardia about 116, no ST elevation
